strength: The spiral tail encloses a turquoise harbour. Tiny boats give the shell terraces a scale that a caption could never supply.
limitation: The harbour and its inhabitants disappear in a tight portrait crop.

strength: The fan of ribs joins a single trumpet-like limb pressed to a circular wall. Negative space makes the body and its instrument one silhouette.
limitation: The almost monochrome foreground needs a generous display size.

strength: A single spectral band crosses the mirror floor and returns through the Warden. The refraction makes its anatomy legible.
limitation: A white overlay would disappear against the prism.

strength: Orchards make a second horizon along the giant’s back; a line of travellers passes beneath its belly. Two scales read immediately.
limitation: The orchard detail needs the uncropped width.

strength: Ribbon fins turn in opposing currents around one long body. The black bridge cuts across the blue water to reveal its size.
limitation: Keep the bottom third; removing the bridge turns it into a conventional sea creature.

strength: A broken bridge invites the eye across blue water into a shaft of daylight. Reef growth claims the stone at its edge.
limitation: Front shadows flatten on very dark displays.

strength: His weight rests on one bent knee while the working prosthetic meets the bridge. The worn timber and half smile tell the same story.
limitation: The map case and bridge mechanism lose definition in a face-only crop.

strength: Stone weights hang free beneath a root-like suspended mass; the tiny travellers below make the void feel immense.
limitation: Shadow separation is fragile at thumbnail size.

strength: A chipped ceramic machine passes a blue vessel into a child’s hands. Its amber chest and the window share one credible light source.
limitation: Keep the right-hand recipient in frame.

strength: The near arch, overhead root and sunlit span build three distinct depths. The path through the landscape remains visible.
limitation: Dense foliage becomes texture below card size.

strength: A held lens, a chart and three lines of sight explain the navigator’s craft. The harbour stays present through the left-hand opening.
limitation: The chart is a narrative prop; its marks cannot support navigational claims.

strength: Overlapping gold segments descend beside a luminous green seam, steering the eye to the gripping mouthparts.
limitation: Show the whole diagonal so the creature reads as more than ornament.

strength: A walking vaulted structure fills the crossing; lantern-bearing residents supply scale and explain the energy it takes.
limitation: The amber light is dense enough to swallow superimposed type.

strength: Claw tracks in a wet stone parapet interrupt a long autumn aqueduct. The foreground evidence gives the distant ruin a plot.
limitation: Keep the parapet foreground in the composition.

strength: The cutaway-like translucency, cloud belly and tiny suspended bell establish identity across four views without relying on scenery.
limitation: A studio reference; the larger-on-screen cinematic version introduces a scale discrepancy.

strength: The low jaw crushes stone at ground level while the furnace light stays behind it. The human silhouettes make the mass believable.
limitation: The dark stone hide can merge with the trench in a small card.

strength: The teal flight membranes stretch across the valley; the red seed pouch remains readable against the warm fur.
limitation: The wing rig is a concept and needs mechanical resolution for animation.

strength: A suspended hull, timber gantries and wet paving locate the viewer inside a working arsenal. Amber light gives a route out to water.
limitation: The far harbour recedes on mobile without the full horizontal view.

strength: The pincer breaks the waterline beneath the dock; spray, cables and timber meet at a single point of force.
limitation: The tight crop makes the complete body plan ambiguous.

strength: A taut cord bridges the gap between the small courier and the parcel. Light fur separates cleanly from the distant market.
limitation: The familiar fox silhouette relies on the exchange and blue hardware for identity.
